Installation guides

Set up MOJO 4K in minutes

Pick your device and follow the steps. Stuck? Give us a shout on WhatsApp and we’ll walk you through it, step by step.

Amazon Firestick & Fire TVSamsung, LG & Hisense Smart TVAndroid TV, Android box & phoneiPhone, iPad & Apple TVMAG box & FormulerWindows, Mac & web browser

Amazon Firestick & Fire TV

  1. From the home screen go to Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options and turn on Apps from Unknown Sources (on newer models, enable Install unknown apps for Downloader).
  2. Search for and install the free Downloader app from the Amazon Appstore.
  3. Open Downloader and enter the download link for your IPTV app (we send it with your login), or install IPTV Smarters Pro / TiviMate.
  4. Open the IPTV app, choose Login with Xtream Codes API and enter the username, password and server URL we sent you.
  5. Wait for channels, films and box sets to load, then start watching.

Samsung, LG & Hisense Smart TV

  1. Open your TV’s app store (Samsung Apps or LG Content Store).
  2. Install IBO Player, Smart One or IPTV Smarters Pro (where available).
  3. Open the app and note the MAC address and device key shown on screen.
  4. Send those details to us on WhatsApp, or add your playlist on the app’s website using the M3U link we sent.
  5. Restart the app. Your channels appear within a minute or two.

Android TV, Android box & phone

  1. Open the Google Play Store.
  2. Install IPTV Smarters Pro, TiviMate or OTT Navigator (works on Sony, Philips, TCL and Hisense Android TVs too).
  3. Open the app and choose Xtream Codes login (TiviMate: Add playlist → Xtream Codes).
  4. Enter the server URL, username and password from your welcome message.
  5. Channels, EPG and VOD load automatically.

iPhone, iPad & Apple TV

  1. Open the App Store.
  2. Install IPTV Smarters Player Lite, iPlayTV or GSE Smart IPTV.
  3. Choose Add user / Xtream Codes.
  4. Enter the server URL, username and password we sent you.
  5. Save, and your channels and on-demand library will load.

MAG box & Formuler

  1. Send us your box’s MAC address (on the sticker underneath, starting 00:1A:79) when you order.
  2. On the box go to Settings → System settings → Servers → Portals.
  3. Enter a portal name (e.g. MOJO 4K) and the portal URL we send you.
  4. Save and restart the box.
  5. The portal loads with your channels. Formuler users can add the same portal in MyTVOnline.

Windows, Mac & web browser

  1. Download IPTV Smarters Pro for Windows or Mac, or use VLC with the M3U link we sent.
  2. In Smarters choose Login with Xtream Codes API and enter your details.
  3. In VLC choose Media → Open Network Stream and paste the M3U link.
  4. Prefer no install? Ask us for the web player link and watch in your browser.
